purpose: Mechanism audit at the start of head FT, not a score or training improvement test.
data_role: Only FT-training validation rows: pure chains with fold !=0; evaluation fold0 never sampled. This is training-side use despite the source filename valid.parquet.
sampling: Four distinct chains per target-derived market class, sorted by SHA256(TDIAG1:chain_id), then smallest eligible row group per chain; 16 sequences total. Target-derived class is sampling metadata only, never a model input.
input_use: Raw feature prefix[0:4000], full20k training targets to construct next-change auxiliary labels, training is_scored masks. Future training labels never feed trunk. Full-sequence labels are legitimate supervision and not deployable state.
identity: Immutable input inventory before model forward: checkpoint, split/classes, source code and plan SHA256; selected raw-prefix/full-target/full-mask byte hashes; parquet stat fingerprint before/after. No need to reread whole parquet.
calculation: CPU float32 replay prefix4000 in microbatches4 with dropout0; concatenate detached [GRU,z]; independently compute main/structure/next gradients on head for windows0:2000 and2000:4000 (warmup mask removes first99). Main gcorr uses |clip(y)| weights and un-clipped p; structure and next masks match head-FT source code. No optimizer update; no held-out WP, no model output cache.
outputs: shared-head gradient cosines and norms per component
separate main-output-row and auxiliary-output-row gradient norms, to distinguish shared-layer interference from global clipping coupling
auxiliary mask and metric mass by class
mode_limits: Reference dropout0, no stochastic encoder/head layers; eval and train model modes coincide mathematically. Float32 CPU replay is not GPU AMP numerical equivalence. No historical Adam trajectory is reconstructed.
run_owner: Root only after code review; no remote execution by this agent.
decision: Descriptive mechanism evidence only; no hard cosine gate and no score threshold. Timeout or nonfinite values report incomplete and stop; no resampling or replacement checkpoint.
future_training: See training.md. Revise prior one-epoch C-only proposal to fixed two-epoch head FT matched to V1 schedule; fresh controls mandatory. No GPU training authorized this round.
